floor.description: Medium-warm oak tone, wide board, matte/satin finish hardwood flooring consistent across living, dining, bedroom areas

walls.description: Flat/low-sheen white paint, crisp bright white throughout all rooms

ceiling.description: Flat white ceiling with recessed downlights, consistent across all spaces

kitchen_cabinets.description: Pale bleached ash/maple tone upper and lower cabinets, handleless or minimal handle profile, matte finish

kitchen_benchtop.description: White to light grey engineered stone with subtle veining, waterfall or square edge profile

window_frames.description: Powder-coated matt black aluminium sliding and awning window frames throughout all rooms

door_frames.description: White painted door frames and flush doors with black linear pull handles; sliding frosted glass wardrobe doors with black frames in bedrooms

skirting.description: White painted square-profile skirting boards, consistent throughout all rooms

island_panel.description: Fluted/reeded vertical panel detail on kitchen island base, painted white or off-white to match benchtop and cabinetry

confidence_notes: High confidence on floor tone, wall/ceiling white, black window frames, fluted island panel, and stone benchtop from multiple consistent renders (1, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8). Kitchen cabinet hex is an estimate from the bleached timber veneer visible in renders 1 and 4 — actual tone may vary slightly under different lighting. Bathroom tiles (grey terrazzo/marble-look) are noted as permanent but excluded from main schema as no bathroom field was specified; they appear as large-format grey stone-look tiles with black fixtures (render 9). Skirting and door frames are both white and visually similar — distinction made based on material/context.
